title: Adoption Telemetry: Measuring Enterprise AI Adoption from Production Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.23617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce adoption telemetry: a method for measuring enterprise AI adoption by computing change-management stage-progression directly from production usage signals. We contribute (1) a framework unifying pre-deployment evaluation gates, production telemetry, and change-management staging into one instrumented system; (2) NANTE, a concrete five-stage operationalization with defined telemetry thresholds, published openly so they can be tested and disproven; and (3) an open-source reference implementation that distinguishes a healthy cohort from five characteristic adoption-failure modes on synthetic populations with known ground truth. We are explicit that the thresholds are proposed constructs requiring empirical validation against real outcomes -- a research agenda we outline -- not a calibrated model.

translated_title: 采用遥测：从生产信号中衡量企业AI采用情况
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23617v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们引入了采用遥测：一种通过直接从生产使用信号中计算变更管理阶段进展来衡量企业AI采用情况的方法。我们贡献了（1）一个框架，将部署前评估门控、生产遥测和变更管理阶段统一到一个仪器化系统中；（2）NANTE，一个具体的五阶段操作化方案，定义了遥测阈值，并公开出版以便测试和反驳；（3）一个开源参考实现，能在具有已知地面真值的合成群体上区分健康群体与五种特征性采用失败模式。我们明确表示，这些阈值是提议的构念，需要针对实际结果进行实证验证——这是我们概述的研究议程——而非校准模型。
tldr: 本文提出采用遥测方法，通过生产信号统一评估和监控企业AI采用阶段，并开源了五阶段操作化框架及参考实现，但强调阈值需实证验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces adoption telemetry, a method to measure enterprise AI adoption stages from production signals, with an open-source five-stage framework and reference implementation, emphasizing thresholds require empirical validation.
